title: Frontend Engineer
raw_description: We're hiring a Frontend Engineer to build customer-facing dashboards. Must have strong TypeScript and React experience, including hooks and state management. You'll work closely with backend engineers consuming REST APIs, so comfort reading FastAPI/OpenAPI schemas is expected. Experience with data visualisation libraries is required. Exposure to geospatial or mapping APIs is a bonus given some of our routing features. No specific degree required - we care about a strong portfolio or GitHub history. Applicants must be able to work on-site in Sydney at least 3 days a week.
